steps.content: I have to show you a grand adventure unique to Whitesands!
Scorching sand, clear skies, and the blazing sun!
Get a new hairstyle, throw on some light clothes, hop in the car, and put the pedal to the metal!
A fight to the death against desperados? That's the most common beginning of an adventure story!
Of course, there will be bounty hunters too! They're all the same, cunning yet generous. Bang. They always hit the bullseye with a wide grin!
The wind, the car races, and the sand that gets into your mouth from all the laughter...
Blow it up, blow it up! Dazzle everyone with a mind-blowing hero's entrance!
...Ha, do you even need to ask?
Of course it's the great hero who beat the desert bandits, tamed the bounty hunters, and defeated all the chumps...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Bounty my ass! Quit acting cool and save your own f**king skin first! Why am I driving??? I don't have a license, ahhhh!
The engine roars, and bullets whiz through the air. Hella screams as she grips the dune buggy's steering wheel.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I haven't even sat in the driver's seat much, let alone get a license! If we crash into something, we're all f**king doomed!
The figure next to Hella leisurely flicks the brim of her hat and gazes at the relentless pursuers behind with a smile.
There's a first for everything. I was around your age when I first drove, too.
This is the steering wheel, and that's the gas pedal. Got it? Now drive!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhh! We're flipping! We're gonna flip over!!!!
